offers_products.reason: Manufactures steel, plastic and fibre drums, IBCs, containerboard, paperboard, tubes and cores.

offers_services.reason: Filling, packaging, reconditioning services exist but are secondary to manufactured packaging products.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Industrial packaging sold to chemical, food, paint and lubricant companies and distributors, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells drums, IBCs and containerboard to manufacturers, chemical companies, fillers and distributors.

recurring_revenue.reason: Packaging is a repeat-order consumable bought regularly by industrial fillers and distributors.

cyclical_demand.reason: Industrial packaging volumes track manufacturing and chemical activity, falling in downturns, though food and essentials cushion.

big_ticket.reason: Drums, IBCs and containers are low-cost, frequently reordered supplies.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured packaging goods, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Serves global chemical, lubricant, paint and food manufacturers, though it also serves customers of all sizes and distributors.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates many global manufacturing plants and paper mills, plus timber properties, requiring ongoing capital investment.

notes: Customer size mix is partly uncertain; the site says it serves customers of all sizes.
